chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibrahim ibn Mihzam, from Talha ibn Yazeed, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Do not sell the debt by the debt'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on selling a debt with another debt in Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) via the Prophet (PBUH) establishes the prohibition of 'bay' al-dayn bi al-dayn' (selling debt for debt), a key principle in Shia jurisprudence to prevent gharar (uncertainty) and riba (usury). It underscores the requirement of actual possession or certainty of repayment when transferring liabilities, ensuring fairness in commercial contracts. This ruling is foundational for modern Islamic finance models dealing with debt securitization and credit transfers.
